verdict.rationale: Aircall documents Messages endpoints for sending SMS programmatically and messaging webhooks for tracking SMS activity, so it covers the core send path and some event-driven inbound tracking. The evidence is limited to brief tutorial blurbs and never explicitly mentions receiving inbound SMS through the API or delivery-status (sent/delivered/failed) callbacks. Missing for 10: explicit inbound SMS receipt documentation, documented delivery status callback events, endpoint-level reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
